title: Shusse Mahjong Daisettai
overview:
Business-entertainment mahjong debuts!! Not just winning, but letting your opponent win - "strategic mahjong" is something new!

Story Mode
You start as a rank-and-file employee of the trading company "Ikku Shouji." First, your promotion to entertainment manager depends on it. From there, win the favor of the key sales figures in the company, succeed in entertaining many clients, and climb the ladder. You will make connections with business leaders, bureaucrats, and Diet members. How far you rise depends on your mahjong. Gathering information is also important... you might unexpectedly lose your footing?!

For example
1. On a client's orders, thoroughly crush someone you dislike!
2. Make sure the client's customer wins!
3. Win only by self-draw and show off your strength!
4. Never finish a hanchan at plus-minus zero or below!
5. Deal into the target player again and again and lose badly!

Salon Mode
Of course, normal mahjong is OK too! You can freely choose your table members from 30 characters.

接待麻雀初登場!!勝つだけでなく、相手に勝たせる「戦略麻雀」が新しい！

◆ストーリーモード◆
貴方は総合商社「一九商事」の平社員からスタートです。先ずは、接待担当主任に昇進が条件。それにより社内の核となる営業の人物に気に入られ、数々の取引先の接待に成功し昇進を重ねます。財界人から官僚、代議士ともコネクションを作ります。何処まで出世できるかは貴方の麻雀にかかっています。また、情報収集も大切……案外失脚が?!

例えば
1.取引先の指令で嫌な奴を徹底的に叩きのめせ！
2.取引先のお客様をバッチリ勝たせろ！
3.ツモばかりで上がって強さを見せつけろ！
4.自分は絶対にプラスマイナス0以下では、半荘終了するな！
5.ひたすらターゲットの人に振り込んでボロ負けしろ！

◆サロンモード◆
もちろん普通の麻雀もOK！メンツは登場人物30人から自由に選べます。
